title: Momoi Airi — What I Can Do For Them〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: What I Can Do For Them（2★）

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our show was a huge success, and I was thinking we could talk about what to do next but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori's still not here. Again!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It's her day to care for the animals today, so she'll be running late.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Should we wait until she gets here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're so fired up, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course I am! We put on a great show, and we're finally getting off the ground!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, also! Our show reminded me of something! I want you all to take a look at this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was going through the comments people posted about our show and finally found this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, they're talking about Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This person said, It's pretty amazing how she learned to dance like that in such a short amount of time, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They're starting to see just how hard she works.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They are. Honestly, there should be more people commenting on how well she did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I found this too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Look. This is from someone's blog...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This person looks like they're a fan of a lot of different idols. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is the newbie idol, Minori Hanasato, there to create buzz for the group...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Including one girl who has no professional experience in the business may be a ploy to attract attention to the group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was under this impression and believed that others may be as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, the joint stream and show they recently put on seems to prove otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The other members of the group seem to solemnly believe in her based on that performance. At least, that is now my understanding.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, this person's got a good eye! Thank you, that's what we've been trying to say!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I'll start looking for comments and posts about Minori too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, let's all look her up online while we wait for her to get here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Let's find as much as we can and give her the good news.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's not her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Her name alone might not be enough. Maybe a different keyword or something will...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, I know. You're not sure how to look things up, right? Here, give me your phone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You go here and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay. Press search and...
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Look! There's a video about copying Minori's part of our dance routine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right! Someone already posted a video like this...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there's a comment from the poster too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They said, I keep messing up the same part! How on earth did Minori learn to do this...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. The answer is moxie, willpower and trying until you succeed!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You sound so proud of her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey, I found another one too.
Look, caricatures of us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, Minori's in the middle too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The person that posted this seems to be a big idol fan too. The fact that they put Minori in the middle means...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They have better eyes than all those dumb judges that kept failing Minori during her auditions!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It looks like they put a lot of effort into this too! It's almost as if they really care about her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like you're staring into a mirror, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi actually mentioned something about Minori the other day, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She said she doesn't want Minori to experience the same thing she did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She was so worried about Minori too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see, so that's why...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you two grinning like that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't mind us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That definitely means you're not telling me something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on, out with it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a secret...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You are hiding something!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ugh! Just tell me already...!
